)

                password_bytes, salt=salt_bytes, n=n, r=r, p=p, maxmem=maxmem

            iterations = DEFAULT_PBKDF2_ITERATIONS
        elif len_args == 1:

import pytest
from werkzeug.security import safe_join
import werkzeug.security as security
from types import SimpleNamespace
import posixpath


def test_safe_join_windows_device_names_rejected(monkeypatch):
    # Emulate Windows environment
    monkeypatch.setattr(security, 'os', SimpleNamespace(name='nt', path=posixpath))
    device_names = [
        'CON', 'con', 'CoN',
        'PRN', 'prn', 'PrN',
        'AUX', 'aux', 'AuX',
        'NUL', 'nul', 'NuL',
        'COM1', 'com1', 'CoM1',
        'LPT9', 'lpt9', 'LpT9',
    ]
    for name in device_names:
        assert safe_join('trusted', name) is None


def test_safe_join_windows_normal_paths_still_work(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(security, 'os', SimpleNamespace(name='nt', path=posixpath))
    assert safe_join('trusted', 'report.txt') == 'trusted/report.txt'
    assert safe_join('trusted', 'sub', 'dir', 'file.log') == 'trusted/sub/dir/file.log'
    # traversal detection still works
    assert safe_join('trusted', '../outside') is None
    assert safe_join('trusted', 'sub', '..', 'secret') is None


def test_safe_join_linux_device_accepted():
    # On POSIX (default) treat device names as ordinary filenames
    assert safe_join('trusted', 'CON') == 'trusted/CON'
    assert safe_join('trusted', 'nul') == 'trusted/nul'
    assert safe_join('trusted', 'COM1') == 'trusted/COM1'
